frank.delta: Hostinger confirms the single-image boot handoff is viable, but also confirms that a writable self.root.udb inode gives frankrunner write reach into immutable-root bytes unless an additional mechanism intervenes.
frank.next_test: Do not adopt strict one-file layout until bounded-write containment beats the split-layout control.

unifieddb.delta: Same-inode physical unity currently expands the writable blast radius from mutable state into immutable root/model address space.
unifieddb.next_test: Design a state commit path that cannot issue arbitrary pwrite against the root/model extents, then attack it on Hostinger.

claycode.delta: Typed region distinctions must survive all the way to the syscall capability; handing O_RDWR for the whole image destroys the semantic boundary.
claycode.next_test: Prove generated/runtime code cannot obtain a general writable fd for self.root.udb and can write only admitted state ranges.

harness.delta: Run 31398279985 demonstrates both E1/E3 PASS_BOUNDED and E5 COUNTEREVIDENCE on digital-retina.
harness.next_test: Proceed to E4 crash cuts and E5 confinement candidates; preserve negative results.

clayresearch.delta: H-EUDI-03 probability rises as mechanism viability; naive H-EUDI-05 falls materially because the deficit replicated on target hardware.
clayresearch.next_test: Prefer experiments capable of rejecting EUDI over additional demonstrations of boot feasibility.

atomic.delta: Invent a physically single-image design without a general writable single-inode capability in the cognitive runtime; otherwise recommend abandoning strict physical unity.
